title: Purple aura above treetops and Bledsoe's 'they're gone now'

tellings.quote: purple ARA that looked like purple glowy smoke right above the Treetops

plain: A man named Bob McGwier, described as a contractor for the CIA (the US foreign spy agency), tells podcast host Jesse Michels about a visit to the North Carolina home of Chris Bledsoe, a man who says he attracts UFOs. McGwier says he saw a purple aura like glowing purple smoke just above the treetops, and that Bledsoe then told him "they're gone now." If true, it would mean a technical outsider saw something unexplained at Bledsoe's home himself.
